title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: A final talk with each player
hook: What would you tell each player about their season?
intro: Each player grew in a different way.
statement: A few words from a coach can carry a kid to next season.
q1: Do you have a short talk with each player —
q2: or write each one a note?
q3: What did each player grow in this year?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids come back
t2: when they know their coach noticed their growth.
cta: Coaches — how do you end the season with players?
ctaLines: A talk. A note. A small award.
ctaPrompt: Share your end-of-season habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What would you tell each player about their season?
The season is over. Each player grew in a different way.
A few words from a coach can carry a kid to next season.
A short talk or a written note. There is no perfect answer.
How do you end the season with players? Share your habit in the comments.
